content:
We are very happy to announce that a Lean Focus Week will be taking place in Bristol on 26-30 October 2026!

The program will be centered around a mini course by Prof Patrick Massot from Tuesday to Thursday, with an introductory colloquium on Monday afternoon. The course will be designed to be open to various levels of expertise. A detailed program and registration link can be found here. A limited amount of funding is available to encourage attendance of external participants from other nearby  universities, especially for students and early career researchers.

Please do not hesitate to share this to relevant contacts and to contact me if you have any questions.

Would you like to advertise this on the Lean community webpage https://leanprover-community.github.io/events.html also? (Short instructions: make a PR to https://github.com/leanprover-community/leanprover-community.github.io/ modifying events.yaml; feel free to DM me if you have any questions!)
